equivalent_mutants.reason: Swapping the zero store of the stack-local index with the CString default constructor 0x4f6439 on the separate local name reorders two writes to disjoint stack words with no outside call between them; 0x4f6439 makes no import or fixture call, so memory, outside calls and the result are identical.

The stack-local index is always overwritten before it is read: 0x4529f0 passes its address to 0x4508d0, which stores atoi(name) into it unconditionally at 0x450920 before any branch, so the initial zero cannot reach any output.

Swapping the default constructor 0x4f6439 of the local name with the copy constructor 0x4f6449 of the argument copy reorders writes to disjoint stack words; 0x4f6439 reads only the static empty-string pointer and makes no outside call, so the only outside call (InterlockedIncrement inside 0x4f6449) keeps its order and arguments and every output is identical.
